newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Wolters Kluwer expands in France.
newsitem.headline: Wolters Kluwer expands in France.

text.p: Wolters Kluwer NV said on Tuesday it had agreed to buy transport and agriculture publishing businesses with a combined annual turnover of some 30 million guilders from Altedia of France.
The Dutch group said it would take over Compagnie Francaise de la Presse (CFP) and Altedia Regions from Altedia.
CFP publishes magazines and organises seminars for the transport industry in France. Its magazine titles include "France Routes" and "Transports Actualites".
Wolters Kluwer said the CFP buy would strengthen its position in the French transport information sector where it already owns Groupe Liaisons, Lamy Transport and Teleroute.
Altedia Regions mainly provides information for the farming sector. Its publications include "Terroir Magazine" and "Agriculture Magazine".
